content.title: Is Erin Krakow Pregnant? Everything You Need to Know About the 'When Calls Heart' Star's Baby Boom
content.text: It's no secret that Erin Krakow of When Calls the Heart is pregnant and due to give birth in the next month or so. The star of Hallmark Channel's longest-running original series announced she was with child in an Instagram post in late November with a quartet of photo booth-style images with husband Ben Rosenbaum, who also stars on the hit series. One of the shots even includes their dog, Willoughby, with a "Big Brother" t-shirt on.Let's learn more about Erin Krakow and her pregnancy, including how it will be handled on When Calls the Heart.🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 Who is Erin Krakow?Erin Krakow is an actress and the lead in Hallmark Channel’s longest-running original series, When Calls the Heart. The premiere of Season 13 was on Sunday, January 4, 2026. Krakow has starred in several Hallmark films including The Wedding Cottage, Above the Clouds, and the Finding Father Christmas trilogy of movies. In 2024, she starred opposite her When Calls the Heart co-star, Daniel Lissing, in Santa Tell Me. She previously appeared on Army Wives, NCIS, and Castle.Related: When Calls the Heart Star Finds Romance in New Hallmark Holiday Movie Christmas Above the Clouds (Exclusive)Who is Erin Krakow's husband?Ben Rosenbaum is an actor, primarily on When Calls the Heart, where he plays Mike Hickam, the town’s Everyman. Originally, the character was kind of a bumbling guy; he later became a business owner, and for a short while, mayor of Hope Valley. He recently starred in The Christmas Cup opposite Rhiannon Fish.Related: Two Rival Towns Battle in a Holiday Head-to-Head in Hallmark’s The Christmas Cup (Exclusive)How long have Erin Krakow and Ben Rosenbaum been dating?While it's unclear how long the two have been dating, both Krakow and Rosenbaum have been on the series since the first season. While they weren't "Instagram Official" until recent years, fans seemed to be aware of their pairing in the early seasons of the show.When did Erin Krakow and Ben Rosenbaum get married?The two tied the knot earlier this year in June in front of a small group of family and friends.Is Erin Krakow pregnant?Yes. Erin Krakow is very much pregnant and due to give birth within a matter of weeks, if not days. If you caught any video of her from The Hallmark Christmas Experience from a few weeks ago, you'll see how far along she is.When did Erin Krakow announce she was pregnant?Both Erin and Ben posted to their Instagram accounts a quartet of Photo booth-style images announcing they were expecting. Images of them with the sonogram, of Ben kissing Erin, of Erin kissing Ben, even an image of their dog Willoughby with a "Big Brother" shirt on. Check it out below.When is Erin Krakow's baby due?While an exact due date has not been announced, we suspect Krakow is due to give birth within the next month or so at the latest. We do know of the three cast members that are expecting kids, all three of expecting births within a six-week period of one another.Related: 3 Babies in 6 Weeks?! A Massive Baby Boom is Blessing the Cast of When Calls the Heart—See Which Stars are Expecting!Did they write Krakow's pregnancy into When Calls the Heart?No. They did not write Krakow's pregnancy into the storyline of When Calls the Heart as her character and Nathan (Kevin McGarry) are still in the courtship phase of their relationship. The big tease of this season is if and when Nathan will propose to Elizabeth and how he'll do it.How do they hide Krakow's pregnancy on When Calls the Heart?Filming began back in July of 2025 and wrapped in October. Krakow was likely in the early stages of her pregnancy at the beginning of production, so you'll see her in looser-fitting clothing as was the style of that era - think 1920s flapper-style, so no constricting corsets like she's worn in the past. We imagine she'll show more toward the end of the season and we'll see Krakow standing behind her school desk and podium, carrying schoolbooks or lunch pails, or other items that will hide her pregnancy.Related: A New 'When Calls the Heart' Spinoff is Coming — What to Know About 'Hope Valley: 1874'This story was originally published by Parade on Jan 5, 2026, where it first appeared in the Celebs section.
